tasks.title: Implement applyObjectTypeConfigurationDefaults() in SettingsInitializer
tasks.description: Add a private helper that derives schema→register mapping from docudesk_register.json, then writes IAppConfig keys per object type with empty-check gating to preserve admin overrides.
acceptance_criteria: New private method applyObjectTypeConfigurationDefaults(array $importResult, array $jsonDef): void called from initialize() after importFromApp succeeds, including the up-to-date branch
Schema→register map derived at runtime from $jsonDef['components']['registers'][*]['schemas'][]; not hardcoded in PHP

For each schema in the derived map AND $importResult['schemas'], resolve register by slug and write {schemaSlug}_source / _register / _schema only when current IAppConfig value is empty; otherwise log info and skip
Missing schema or register slugs in the import result are skipped with a warning log, no exception
Empty or missing components.registers in JSON causes the method to log info and return cleanly; PHPCS / PHPMD / Psalm / PHPStan all clean

tasks.title: Wire the helper into SettingsInitializer::initialize()
tasks.description: Capture importFromApp return value and call the helper from initialize(), including the version-up-to-date branch.
acceptance_criteria: Return value of $configurationService->importFromApp(...) is captured in a local variable
applyObjectTypeConfigurationDefaults(...) is invoked with both the import result and the parsed JSON definition
The helper is also invoked when importFromApp returns the up-to-date / no-changes path
On exception inside the helper, initialize() logs but does not propagate — helper failure must not break app boot

tasks.title: Unit tests for the helper
tasks.description: Cover happy path, override preservation, partial override, missing-from-result, empty JSON, and _source-key behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Test class follows DocuDesk conventions (declare strict_types=1, namespace Unit\Service, PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase)
Six cases as separate test methods: fresh install, override preservation, partial override (per-key gating), missing-from-import-result, empty components.registers, _source key set to 'openregister'

Assertions confirm both expected writes AND expected non-writes via expects(never())->method('setValueString') for preserved keys; tests run via docker exec -w /var/www/html/custom_apps/docudesk nextcloud php vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-unit.xml --filter SettingsInitializerTest

tasks.title: Integration test against ConsentCrudService::getConsentConfig()
tasks.description: Confirm getConsentConfig returns the auto-populated values on fresh install, and still returns null when keys are cleared.
acceptance_criteria: Test confirms that after SettingsInitializer::initialize() runs on a fresh-install fixture, getConsentConfig() returns ['register' => <id>, 'schema' => <id>] without admin interaction
Test confirms that when the IAppConfig keys are cleared, getConsentConfig() returns null (failure-mode preserved); documents that auto-default is the only path populating these keys
